rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior-to-staff product manager for software product development, leading products from conception through rollout and coordinating product, engineering, design, sales, and marketing.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Senior-to-staff-level product management seniority.
- 6+ years of experience in the software industry.
- Previous experience in engineering and/or design roles.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: North America or Europe (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in one of these places. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
